reports.text: Phillies need to make gains this offseason.
Aidan Miller’s progress early next season will be one of the Phillies top storylines. Here’s a preview of what fans might be getting. ￼

Phillies announce they’ve signed Don Mattingly to a two-year deal (so through ‘27 and ‘28), as @MattGelb and @charlottevarnes said they would. Fascinating decision for a team facing a fascinating offseason.
